# 5.37 — day 1 from template

**Purpose:** Give a new product team an ordered, no-guesswork path from a fresh template clone to the first implementation queue item. Documentation and plans are generated by humans and AI agents; CI must not auto-generate or rewrite docs.

## Preconditions

- You have cloned this template into the repository that will become the product repository.
- Python 3.12+, Git, Docker, and Make are available. Windows users can run the Unix commands in Git Bash, WSL, or PowerShell equivalents shown below.
- You know the product name, one-line mission, active profiles, and first bounded contexts well enough to update `AGENTS.md` and `IDEA.md`.

## Inputs

- Product name/slug, for example `acme-portal`.
- Completed or draft `IDEA.md`.
- Human approval for any security, tenancy, or data-integrity assumptions that are not explicit in `IDEA.md`.

## Outputs

- Template names replaced in `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, package metadata, and root project metadata.
- `IDEA.md` completed enough for `skills/init/repo_initialize.md`.
- Initialization PR containing refreshed docs and seed queue rows.
- First implementation PR created from `queue/queue.csv` after initialization.

## Ordered steps

### 1. Clone and enter the repository

Unix / Git Bash / WSL:

```bash
git clone <template-repo-url> <product-repo>
cd <product-repo>
```

PowerShell:

```powershell
git clone <template-repo-url> <product-repo>
Set-Location <product-repo>
```

### 2. Rename the baseline

Unix / Git Bash / WSL:

```bash
python3 scripts/rename-from-template.py acme-portal \
  --system-name "Acme Portal" \
  --mission "Run Acme customer operations from one secure portal." \
  --archetype "full-stack modular monolith" \
  --profiles "api, web" \
  --contexts "auth, users, customer-operations"
```

PowerShell:

```powershell
python scripts/rename-from-template.py acme-portal `
  --system-name "Acme Portal" `
  --mission "Run Acme customer operations from one secure portal." `
  --archetype "full-stack modular monolith" `
  --profiles "api, web" `
  --contexts "auth, users, customer-operations"
```

Run a dry run first when you want to preview files without writing them:

```bash
python3 scripts/rename-from-template.py acme-portal --dry-run
```

### 3. Sweep for remaining template tokens

Unix / Git Bash / WSL:

```bash
python3 scripts/template_token_sweep.py acme-portal
```

PowerShell:

```powershell
python scripts/template_token_sweep.py acme-portal
```

Review every `file:line` in the report. Replace only values that truly belong to the product. Some generic words such as “template” in procedure names may be intentionally retained when they describe the reusable template workflow.

### 4. Complete `IDEA.md`

Fill every applicable section of `IDEA.md`; write `N/A` for sections that do not apply. Escalate instead of guessing when security, tenancy, compliance, external integrations, or data-retention behavior is unclear.

### 5. Run the initialization skill

Ask an AI agent to run the canonical initialization skill:

```text
Run skills/init/repo_initialize.md against IDEA.md. Produce docs, ADRs, open questions, and MVP queue rows only; do not write product code.
```

The agent must follow `AGENTS.md`, `queue/QUEUE_INSTRUCTIONS.md`, and `docs/procedures/initialize-repo.md`.

### 6. Validate the initialized repository

Unix / Git Bash / WSL:

```bash
make queue:validate
make docs:check
python3 scripts/check_docs_map.py
python3 scripts/repo_self_audit.py
```

PowerShell:

```powershell
make queue:validate
make docs:check
python scripts/check_docs_map.py
python scripts/repo_self_audit.py
```

### 7. Start implementation from the queue

After the initialization PR lands, start with the first open non-`human-ops` row:

```bash
make queue:top-item
```

Read the row, its `context_files`, `touch_files`, and relevant skills before writing code. Implementation agents do not edit `queue/queue.csv` or `queue/queuearchive.csv`; operators archive rows after PR review and merge.

## Acceptance

- `scripts/rename-from-template.py` has been run or deliberately skipped with a documented reason.
- `scripts/template_token_sweep.py <project-name>` has been reviewed and remaining template tokens are either replaced or accepted.
- `IDEA.md` is complete enough for initialization.
- `make queue:validate`, `make docs:check`, `python3 scripts/check_docs_map.py`, and `python3 scripts/repo_self_audit.py` pass or have documented environment-limited warnings.
- The first implementation queue item is started only after initialization outputs are reviewed.
